title: Audit Policy Changes Report
description: Changes to unified, traditional, and fine-grained audit policy configuration.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Operation' in ('AUDIT','NOAUDIT','CREATE AUDIT POLICY','ALTER AUDIT POLICY','DROP AUDIT POLICY','EXECUTE') | fields Time, 'Data Safe Target Name', 'Database User', 'Operation', 'Object Owner', 'Object Name', 'FGA Policy Name', 'Operation Status' | sort -Time
